source.name: U.S. EIA Form EIA-860 Annual Electric Generator Report

fields.name: plant_code
fields.description: EIA plant code (ORISPL); primary key.

fields.name: plant_name
fields.description: Plant name as reported on EIA-860 Schedule 2.

fields.name: utility_id
fields.description: EIA utility ID of the reporting operator.

fields.name: utility_name
fields.description: Operating utility name.

fields.name: street_address
fields.description: Plant street address. Placeholders 'N/A', 'NA', 'TBD' and 'TBA' (used for proposed sites) -> null.

fields.name: city
fields.description: Plant city. Placeholders 'N/A', 'NA', 'TBD' and 'TBA' -> null.

fields.name: county
fields.description: Plant county.

fields.name: state
fields.description: Two-letter state code.

fields.name: zip
fields.description: 5-digit ZIP code (string, zero-padded).

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Plant latitude (WGS84), 6 decimals.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Plant longitude (WGS84), 6 decimals.

fields.name: distance_mi
fields.description: Haversine distance from the region center, 1 decimal.

fields.name: nerc_region
fields.description: NERC region code.

fields.name: balancing_authority_code
fields.description: Balancing authority code (e.g. CISO, LDWP, IID).

fields.name: balancing_authority_name
fields.description: Balancing authority name.

fields.name: sector_name
fields.description: EIA sector name (e.g. Electric Utility, IPP Non-CHP).

fields.name: grid_voltage_kv
fields.description: Primary grid interconnection voltage.

fields.name: primary_source
fields.description: source_category with the most operable nameplate MW (null if no operable generators).

fields.name: nameplate_mw
fields.description: Sum of nameplate capacity of operable generators.

fields.name: summer_capacity_mw
fields.description: Sum of net summer capacity of operable generators (blanks count as 0).

fields.name: winter_capacity_mw
fields.description: Sum of net winter capacity of operable generators (blanks count as 0).

fields.name: operable_generator_count
fields.description: Number of operable generators (status OP/SB/OS/OA).

fields.name: proposed_generator_count
fields.description: Number of proposed generators.

fields.name: proposed_mw
fields.description: Sum of nameplate capacity of proposed generators.

fields.name: planned_retirement_mw
fields.description: Nameplate MW of operable generators that report a planned retirement year.

fields.name: oldest_operating_year
fields.description: Earliest operating year among operable generators.

fields.name: newest_operating_year
fields.description: Latest operating year among operable generators.

fields.name: capacity_weighted_year
fields.description: Nameplate-weighted mean operating year of operable generators, rounded.

fields.name: capacity_weighted_age_years
fields.description: Nameplate-weighted mean age of operable generators relative to report year 2025, 1 decimal.

fields.name: technologies
fields.description: Pipe-joined, sorted unique EIA technology names of operable generators.
